implementation.owner: OfficeIMO.Html canonical column/page planners and fragment paint; existing shared paragraph, boundary and shape metadata owners are reused.

supportedContract: Eligible ordinary horizontal auto-fill column hosts honor direct full-width spanners' own forced page-before/page-after targets and fitting page keeps through the canonical page planner.
Terminal columns use the physical origin after those page jumps and keeps, including partial-page entry and left/right parity.
Preceding column rules can fill unused page-body space before a forced spanner page break while source coordinates and fragment membership stay unchanged.
Direct spanner column-only controls are inactive without an outer column context. Page controls are inactive in continuous and snapshot layout.

packages.boundary: net8/net10 and macOS arm64 NativeAOT execute; net472/netstandard2.0 assets compile only. No Windows execution or public release.

svg.rasterPolicy: Independent Poppler rasterization of native Edge SVG PDFs and qualified product PDFs at actual normal 96dpi. Whole unmasked pages, same-origin white padding for page rounding only; no crop, scaling, registration, mask or synthetic scene PNG. Raw MAE and difference maps remain descriptive.
svg.boundary: Native rendering of exact exported SVG bytes is separate from native HTML and managed PNG/PDF replay. No pixel-identical native appearance claim.

nativeHtmlVisual.observations: All12 original96dpi Edge HTML/product PDF pairs were visually inspected. Full-width headings, all tail labels, following paragraph and actual page-edge rule extents agree in these two native-matched subjects. Edge retains tiny blue boundary dots on the later spanner/following page; product correctly clips the rule there. Font and line antialiasing differs slightly. No pixel-identical native claim.
nativeHtmlVisual.boundary: Two native-matched cases only. Tiny native blue edge dots and font antialiasing residuals do not establish general pixel equality.

invoice.boundary: Exact audit input and new HtmlToPdfOptions() defaults; historical Edge155 two-page controls lack resolved OS-font byte hashes. No current native font-byte or pixel-equivalence claim.

independentReview.mode: fresh strictly read-only local pass; no builds/tests/producers/browser

cases.boundaryReason: Edge ignores an applicable page force after a direct spanner when a local column set follows. OfficeIMO honors the CSS force; native equivalence is not claimed.
Edge ignores the spanner page-after force before a following authored column boundary. OfficeIMO honors the page force; native equivalence is not claimed.
Edge separates the spanner from its following fitting content despite avoid-page. OfficeIMO applies the shared page keep; native equivalence is not claimed.

Finite-height overflow produces different print shrink and screen-media pagination. Edge clips three labels and scales its print output. Candidate source, replay and observed placement are checked; native or complete finite-overflow conformance is not claimed.
Edge ignores page-after before the next column set and second spanner. OfficeIMO applies the force; native equivalence is not claimed.
Edge separates the preceding column row from the spanner despite a fitting avoid-page range. OfficeIMO retains the fitting range; native equivalence is not claimed.
Edge separates the spanner from the next first line despite a fitting avoid-page range. OfficeIMO retains the fitting range; native equivalence is not claimed.
Edge treats the right-page target as a plain page break. OfficeIMO preserves right-page parity with a blank second page; native equivalence is not claimed.

Root observed repeated painted native PDF text across physical page edges for the relative-position witness (RPRLP-T04, RPRLP-T08, RPRLP-T13, RPRLP-T18). The candidate retains each logical source token once. First-page rule ink matches the native witness, but native PDF token multiplicity is a paint/extraction boundary. Accepted candidate preservation/export positions apply only to the declared paged profiles; no native or specification conformance is claimed there.

Root observed repeated painted native PDF text across physical page edges for the relative-position witness (RPRLN-S01, RPRLN-T09, RPRLN-T14). The candidate retains each logical source token once. First-page rule ink matches the native witness, but native PDF token multiplicity is a paint/extraction boundary. Accepted candidate preservation/export positions apply only to the declared paged profiles; no native or specification conformance is claimed there.

remainingBoundary: Descendant or fragmented spanners and forced breaks inside spanners retain the diagnosed boundary.
Page controls on balanced or otherwise ineligible hosts, nested columns, transformed/vertical regions and atomic/floating hosts remain outside this per-page subset.
Changing page geometry or reserved body space, height-dependent alignment, tall column notes/figures and broader flex/grid intrinsic sizing retain their existing qualification limits.
Pre-spanner sets retain source balancing across page cuts; balanced spanning overflow can retain a diagnosed paint/following-flow approximation.

The seven native-difference cases and three native-paint-boundary cases retain the paged-profile boundaries recorded per case. Their native outputs do not establish equivalence for the differing behavior.
The relative-position witnesses retain native PDF paint/text-extraction differences. Matching first-page rule ink does not establish native glyph/token equivalence.
Windows profiling remains deferred. Local managed proof and unsigned private package proof do not establish Windows execution, public publication, hosted CI/review or deployment.
publication: Branch checkpoint only. No PR, merge, signed/public package release or deployment is established.
